description: Device-local reader history lens (localStorage, never sent or aggregated). Pages are recorded only when opted in with <meta name="vb:track-history" content="on"> or by this element's presence; <html data-vb-no-track> and <meta name="vb:no-track-history"> opt out.

attributes.name: limit
attributes.description: Max page groups rendered. Storage itself is capped separately at 100 entries by the tracker.

attributes.name: include-current
attributes.description: Also list the page the reader is on (excluded by default).

attributes.name: data-heading-level
attributes.description: Heading level 1-6 for the panel heading; 0 renders no heading (e.g. inside content-lens).

attributes.name: data-label-explainer
attributes.default: Stored on this device only. Never sent to a server.

attributes.name: data-label-pause
attributes.description: Pause toggle label (static; aria-pressed carries the state).

attributes.name: data-label-anchors
attributes.description: Anchor-visits toggle label (static; aria-pressed carries the state).

attributes.name: data-label-empty
attributes.description: Message rendered when there is no history.

attributes.name: data-label-anchor-one
attributes.description: Anchor count noun when Intl.PluralRules selects "one".

attributes.name: data-label-anchor-other
attributes.description: Anchor count noun for every other plural category.

events.name: recently-visited:clear
events.description: Fires when the reader clears the local history.

events.name: recently-visited:pause-toggle
events.description: Fires when the reader pauses or resumes tracking.

events.name: recently-visited:anchors-toggle
events.description: Fires when the reader shows or hides anchor visits.

properties.name: entries
properties.type: Array<{ url, hash, title, hashTitle, ts }>
properties.description: Read-only. Stored history, most recent first; expired (30-day TTL), malformed and off-origin records are filtered out.
